ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity-to-high intensity ratio; dominant dark-gray and black pixels occupy approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with white pixels restricted to small focal marks and distal tip anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pixel mass across both lobes; secondary high-intensity point-clusters (white/tan) localized at the extreme distal tips and sparse white linear markings on the lower quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by pixel-amplitude variances of 3-12 pixels, most pronounced on the mid-section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a linear sweep with terminal convexity at the points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct, multi-chromatic (white, tan, and dark brown) circular pixel clusters localized at the far distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological colonization (barnacle clusters) protruding from the distal fluke tips, creating irregular, high-contrast structural silhouettes against the water background.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral accumulation of biological encrustation is the primary distinguishing visual feature, significantly altering the 2D geometric profile of the fluke tips.
